<command>git diff 8c9d0e1..a4b5c6d</command>

I don't have the paths or names from Task 2's diff in front of me. So the paths below are the ones that diff shows, and the lines show the change itself.

## 3. TDD the follow-up: RED

Change Task 2's boundary tests to spec § 2. A dock with 2 free slots alerts. A dock with 3 free slots does not.

<edit path="<Task 2's threshold test file, from the diff>">
def test_dock_with_2_free_slots_alerts():
    assert should_alert(free_slots=2) is True

def test_dock_with_3_free_slots_does_not_alert():
    assert should_alert(free_slots=3) is False
</edit>

Any Task 2 test that asserted "3 free slots alerts" is replaced by the second test above, not just deleted.

<command>uv run pytest -q -k "free_slots"</command>

I expect `test_dock_with_3_free_slots_does_not_alert` to fail on the current code (threshold 3). If it passes, the test isn't reaching the threshold, and I fix the test before touching the code.

## 4. GREEN

<edit path="<Task 2's threshold module, from the diff>">
FREE_SLOT_THRESHOLD = 2  # spec § 2: alert at 2 or fewer free slots
</edit>

<command>uv run pytest -q -k "free_slots"</command>
<command>uv run pytest -q</command>

The full suite must be green, at 25 passed or more if a test was added. If it isn't, the follow-up isn't done and I stop there.
